scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: The Connection Lab prepares supply packs. Tara starts a counter at one and adds two for each pretend pack. Neel writes two after the first pack, forgetting the starting value. The teacher asks them to record the current total before and after every update.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: A loop repeats an action while the state can change each time. Starting at one, four add-two updates produce three, five, seven and nine. The repetition count is four, not nine: one number counts actions, while the other records the resulting total after those actions.
scenes.speech: A loop repeats an action while the state can change each time. Starting at one, four add-two updates produce three, five, seven and nine. The repetition count is four, not nine: one number counts actions, while the other records the resulting total after those actions.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The team checks zero repetitions and one repetition before trying a new starting value. With no updates, the initial one remains unchanged. These boundary checks reveal a forgotten start or an extra action. When the instruction changes, the trace must be recalculated rather than copied from the earlier run.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: Initial value 1; repeat add 2 exactly four times. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: Initial value 1; repeat add 2 exactly four times. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: What is the total after four add-two updates from one?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: The total is nine: one becomes three, five, seven, then nine. Four counts updates; nine is the final state.
scenes.speech: The total is nine: one becomes three, five, seven, then nine. Four counts updates; nine is the final state.
